about.intro: I’m Javier López Villanueva, a Senior Frontend Engineer / Squad Lead specialising in React, Next.js and TypeScript. I combine hands-on development, frontend architecture and team leadership to turn business needs into reliable, maintainable interfaces.
about.independentWork: Alongside product work, I build multilingual platforms, privacy-conscious tools and a public React component library. My projects include Next CV Builder, Personal & Pilates, Mantenimientos AJ, Template Web Arrow and Lidia Villanueva Bolívar’s website, with a focus on accessibility, user experience and code quality.

jobs.description: I lead a frontend team working on corporate applications while remaining hands-on. I build with React, TypeScript and Material UI / OpenFront, and coordinate architecture, planning, mentoring and code review with backend teams and stakeholders.

I developed and owned Airlinen, a services platform for short-term lets, end to end across backend, frontend, user flows and operations. I delivered features with Ruby on Rails and React, and defined and validated requirements with business stakeholders.
Support and development for university applications: functional analysis, debugging, SQL queries and incident resolution with end users.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.description: Information about the owner and terms of use of this personal portfolio.

The site is personal, informational and non-commercial. It does not offer contracts, product sales or professional services through the website.

Third-party trademarks, names and content belong to their respective owners.

sections.title: External links

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: Reasonable efforts are made to keep information accurate and available, but the complete absence of errors, interruptions or harmful elements cannot be guaranteed. Visitors use the site at their own responsibility.

sections.title: Applicable law
paragraphs: This notice is governed by Spanish law. Disputes will be submitted to the courts with jurisdiction under applicable law.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How personal data is processed when visiting this site.

sections.title: Controller
paragraphs: Data controller: Javier López Villanueva.
Privacy and rights contact: jlopvil@gmail.com.

sections.title: Data processed
paragraphs: The site has no forms, user accounts, subscriptions, comments or advertising analytics. It does not request data directly.

The hosting infrastructure may automatically process technical data required to serve and protect the website, such as IP address, date and time, requested URL, browser, operating system, referrer and security logs.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
paragraphs: Technical data is processed to deliver content, maintain security, prevent abuse and diagnose failures. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in operating a secure and functional website, applying data minimisation.
There is no profiling, automated decision-making, behavioural advertising or marketing communication.

sections.title: Recipients and transfers
paragraphs: The site is hosted by Vercel, which may act as an infrastructure provider and process technical logs. Its providers may be located outside the European Economic Area; where applicable, Vercel states that it uses recognised safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses.
Data is not sold or disclosed for commercial purposes.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: Technical logs are retained only as necessary for security, operation and incident resolution, according to the hosting provider's configuration and retention periods. No proprietary visitor database is created.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access, correction, deletion, objection, restriction or portability by emailing jlopvil@gmail.com and describing your request. Reasonable information may be requested to verify identity.
You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency at www.aepd.es.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: This policy will be updated if the site adds forms, analytics, advertising or other processing. The current version date appears at the top.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: Information about cookies and similar technologies used by this site.

sections.title: Current status
paragraphs: The application does not set first-party analytics, advertising, tracking or personalisation cookies. Language is determined through the URL (/es, /ca or /en) and, on the first visit, the browser's language preference; it is not stored in an application cookie.
No consent banner is displayed because the site does not use non-essential cookies requiring prior authorization.

sections.title: Technical infrastructure
paragraphs: The hosting provider may use strictly necessary mechanisms for security, load balancing or deployment protection when those features are enabled. This application does not use them for analytics or advertising.

sections.title: Third-party services and links
paragraphs: When following a link to another site, that third party's cookie policy and choices apply. This portfolio does not control cookies set by external websites.

sections.title: Future changes
paragraphs: Before adding analytics, advertising or any non-essential cookie, this policy will be updated and a consent mechanism will be implemented that makes accepting and rejecting equally easy.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy: jlopvil@gmail.com.
